title: What Evidence Do AI Agent Audit Logs Need After Redaction? A matched-pair pilot and a reusable toolkit for auditable redaction (code, fixtures, results and paper)
description:
A reusable, standard-library Python toolkit (python3 -m redaction_audit). It tests whether redacted action logs, such as AI agent audit logs, still let a reviewer verify an authorisation policy. Users describe their rule as conditions tagged with evidence needs (equality, order, explicit state, raw value, presence), mark private fields, provide a few authorised logs, and list redaction schemes. The toolkit generates boundary violations and reports per condition whether each scheme keeps verification possible (verified / unverifiable / unsafe), plus direct exposure of private values.

Includes the reproducible pilot study (20 matched runs; full logs, uniform masking, consistent aliases, expiry and revocation ablations) and the technical report. Run python3 run_pilot.py to reproduce the pilot.
